text.tspan: MF2043 Lab 3 - Anti-alias filters, values as built (designators renumbered for one sheet)
(a) Active low-pass, OP462: R1 10 kΩ, R2 100 kΩ || C1 10 nF (159 Hz, gain -10)
Input and op-amp supply share net V+ as in the Eagle file; V- open.
(b) Passive RC low-pass: VR1 10 kΩ, C2 100 µF
(c) Passive band-pass: C3 100 nF, R3 200 Ω, R4 400 Ω, C4 47 nF
Inputs on the +5V net as drawn in the Eagle files.
